messages:
Amira Soliman: Hey everyone  first day on design systems 389 Quick q: should I request a Mac or Linux devbox? Also who handles badge pickup and building access?

Kai (IT): Welcome Amira! For design we usually ship Macs, but Linux devboxes are OK if you need them. DM your shipping address and I'll start the order. For badge pickup fill https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge and choose HQ pickup.

Amira Soliman: Thanks Kai 60a I'll take a Mac. Also how do I get access to the private Figma files and design tokens repo?

Maya Rao: Hey Amira 44b I'm your buddy. Added you to the Figma team and sent the invite. For the repo: generate an SSH key and paste the public key at https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys, then request access to redwood/design-tokens in the UI. I can approve once you request.

Diego (People Ops): Quick note: onboarding emails (benefits/payroll) went to your personal email. Welcome lunch on Friday at noon if you're in SF 37d Please add dietary notes to the lunch RSVP.

Amira Soliman: Awesome, vegetarian and gluten-free here. Also low-stakes fun fact: I collect ceramic mugs from coffee shops 37a

Kai (IT): Ordering the Mac now. MDM enrollment steps (Mac):
```
open /Applications/RedwoodMDM/Enroll.app
# if blocked run: sudo installer -pkg /tmp/RedwoodMDM.pkg -target /
```
Ping if anything blocks.

BuddyBot: Amira Soliman was added to #design and #eng-ui. :tada:
